caption: The drawing depicts two objects, both resembling bonnets or head coverings, set against a plain, light beige background. The larger object is positioned in the upper left quadrant, shown in a three-quarters view, and is primarily colored light blue-green with darker blue-green and grayish lines indicating pleats and texture. This bonnet-like object has a rounded shape with horizontal stitched lines and folds, and a gathered, frilled section at the opening. The second, smaller object is located below and to the right of the larger one, drawn in a lighter, mostly line-based style with minimal color. It shows a similar structure and design but is more schematic and less detailed, with a focus on the lines outlining its form and the same frilled section as the larger object. Both objects have an emphasis on curved, layered surfaces and gathered fabric detailing. The background includes faint stain marks but no additional items or decorative elements.
title: Bonnet
